beats.care: Heading to Church Street cafes this weekend? Expect a cordoned patch, and heavy vehicles are banned from the stretch.
beats.what: On Monday, part of Church Street caved in under a garbage truck. Four days later, the hole is still there.
beats.why: The collapse damaged an underground BWSSB water pipe. GBA officials say full road repairs cannot start until the pipe is fixed.

opts: It's waiting for rain to stop
A damaged water pipe underneath must be fixed first
cards.q: Why can't the GBA just patch the Church Street hole right away?
cards.why: The collapse hit a BWSSB pipeline, so the pipe gets fixed before the road surface.

cards.body: The road's five-year maintenance warranty has run out. Reports say engineers and civic staff aren't sure who is now responsible for its upkeep.
cards.title: Who maintains it?

cards.body: The TenderSURE redo started at about ₹9–11 crore and was reportedly revised to ₹17 crore.
cards.caption: Reported revised cost

hook: Why is *Church Street's sinkhole* still open?

learn.t: Church Street was rebuilt under the TenderSURE model and reopened in March 2018 with granite cobblestones.
